issue_request: FHIR-6832 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core SDC ballot issue reporting that extension definition pages showed the JSON template in the JSON tab but not in the All tab, with the optionalDisplay extension used as the example. The recorded resolution was to fix the renderer/template.

additional_context: The extension template was later moved unchanged from source/template-extension.html to tools/templates/template-extension.html in commit 24e6675dcd8f9f6dbd68745fbcfcafc9b32443b2. Current fhir.ini still carries extensiondefinition in the active work-group/build metadata, while the specific historical SDC optionalDisplay extension is no longer a current core extension source artifact. Community searches found no later decision contradicting the git/source evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current tools/templates/template-extension.html All tab includes a JSON Template block using json-inner and <%json%> at lines 131-135, so the approved correction remains applied.
